title: ILVE — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for ILVE.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "Cucina Italiana." Luxury tier. ILVE has been making ranges in Campodarsego, Italy since 1952. Their Majestic and Nostalgie collections are handcrafted with attention to detail that borders on obsessive. Available in 200+ color and trim combinations, ILVE ranges are for kitchens where the range IS the design statement. Distributed by Tasco in Canada.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Ultra-luxury Italian kitchen designs. Customers who want a colored range as the kitchen centerpiece. Tasco dealer customers.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for ILVE:

• 200+ color and trim combinations — the most customizable Italian range

• Handcrafted in Campodarsego, Italy — small-batch manufacturing

• Majestic collection is professional-grade with up to 7 burners

• Nostalgie collection brings vintage Italian charm

• Tasco distribution provides full dealer support in Canada
